functionalReqs: Rider sees nearby drivers and requests a ride
Match a rider to the best nearby driver; driver accepts or declines
Live trip tracking, fare calculation, payment
hints: Driver locations are write-heavy and short-lived. Should they go into your main database?
Keep driver locations in an in-memory geo index sharded by region (geohash/H3 cells). How do you lock a driver during matching?

Location service (in-memory, sharded by cell), matching/dispatch service that queries nearby cells, ranks by ETA, and offers to one driver at a time with a lock and timeout; trip service with a state machine; surge pricing from supply/demand per cell; WebSockets for live updates.
nonFunctionalReqs: No double assignment of a driver
Highly available across cities; regional failures stay regional
problemStatement:
Design **Uber's** core: riders request a ride, the system matches them with a nearby driver, and both see each other live until the trip ends.

Driver locations change every few seconds and a driver must never be matched to two riders.

scaleHints.qps: Location updates every 4 s ⇒ ~1M+ writes/s; ~10K ride requests/s at peak
scaleHints.storage: Trip history for years; location trail short-term

title: Design Uber (Ride Matching)
